description: Ministry of Investment Promotion - Repealed the Gazette Extra Ordinary No.2375/12 Published on March 11,2024.
categorisation: The gazette content consists of regulations made by the Minister of Investment Promotion under the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka Law, No. 4 of 1978, and specifically repeals a previous gazette extraordinary. This falls under legal/regulatory matters as it involves the creation and amendment of regulations and statutory instruments, which is the core focus of Type 5 classification.
